proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly places Lahnda Awankari macchī, Khetrani machī and Kotgarhi/Kiunthal macchi fish in the second *matsiya branch. The Pothwari/Siraiki and Kullui survey forms match those specific Lahnda and western Pahari comparanda. Gujari and other macchī forms are excluded here because Turner also lists feminine macchī under the main matsya branch.
